    -- char.dat SWORD.EPF: equipImageId 1, twenty direction/action frames.
    property table WoodSwordFrames = {"c2c9b867d3d341dfa450b3cd682bd1ee","c2c9b867d3d341dfa450b3cd682bd1ee","c2c9b867d3d341dfa450b3cd682bd1ee","7ef0414683ee4929a582d510cf65b28e","f9ff7f7d066a4c5f89b09a544fb1d2c7","c2b236f7d4ee458a9b0eacf10895c866","264edc26ff9b413d8ad06e5aeef05c98","264edc26ff9b413d8ad06e5aeef05c98","264edc26ff9b413d8ad06e5aeef05c98","0d760dcc1d934250b94a08a2f7e45607","b1633a7a94034a5a896ea57bb0035a3d","05768b286fd04ae89215fed105f7a8c7","db799eaa71954120b64e352f4ee137d5","b868030fa9b54a3f84f74e99b9846cd7","443ba9d912d4464d92a7a6cadee866ca","e06dbc9bfe9741c991ff1ca3098301ac","b3b40028ce8c4c0a8afff065a3794bdb","02476cc5b42a4ce6b6edc4b18fb4fa50","ca6e31df230d49099a07a781ce636444","50fe5383394641d4a0d7eb646a27fc96"}

    method string GetWeapon(integer itemId, integer frame)
        -- Resolve original worn image and palette dye independently from the item icon.
        if frame < 0 or frame > 19 then return "" end
        local data = _BaramWorldData:Item(itemId)
        if data == nil or data.type ~= 0 then return "" end
        local frames = self.WeaponFrames[tostring(data.equipImageId) .. ":" .. tostring(data.dye)]
        if frames == nil then return "" end
        return frames[frame + 1]
    end

    property string DrawOrder = "wbhs;wbhs;sbhw;sbhw;sbhw;sbhw;bhsw;sbhw;wbhs;wbhs;wbhs;wbhs;wbhs;wbhs;swbh;sbhw;sbhw;sbhw;bhsw;sbhw;bhsw;wbhs;wbhs;wbhs;sbhw;wbhs;sbhw;wsbh;wbhs;sbhw;wbhs;sbwh;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;wbh0;wbh0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;bhw0;wbh0;wbh0;wbh0;whb0;wbh0;whb0;wbh0;wbh0;bhw0;bhw0;rbhw;rbhw;rbhw;rbhw;rwbh;rwbh;bhwr;bhwr;bhwr;rbhw;rwbh;rwbh;bh00;bh00;bh00;bh00;bh00;bh00;bh00;bh00;"

    method string GetDrawOrder(integer frame)
        -- Original DRWORDER.TBL; extra dance frames use the client's bh00 fallback.
        if frame < 0 or frame >= 100 then return "bh00" end
        return string.sub(self.DrawOrder, frame * 5 + 1, frame * 5 + 4)
    end

    method string GetBody(integer gender, integer frame)
        local style = math.max(0, math.min(1, gender)) + 1
        local index = math.max(0, math.min(103, frame))
        if index < 12 then return self.BodyFrames[style][index + 1] end
        return self.MotionBodyFrames[style][index] or self.BodyFrames[style][1]
    end

    method string GetHead(integer hair, integer frame)
        local style = math.max(0, math.min(9, hair)) + 1
        local index = math.max(0, math.min(99, frame))
        if index < 12 then return self.HeadFrames[style][index + 1] end
        return self.MotionHeadFrames[style][index] or self.HeadFrames[style][1]
    end

    method string GetEmotion(integer hair, integer frame)
        local style = math.max(0, math.min(9, hair)) + 1
        return self.EmotionFrames[style][math.max(0, math.min(19, frame))]
    end
end
